authentication.evidence: Production source uses bcrypt password hashing, login rate limiting, a case-insensitive unique email index, 12-character complexity policy, 12-hour signed sessions, and Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax cookies.

cross_tenant_isolation.evidence: 2026-10-07 transaction-scoped negative test created tenant A and tenant B and attempted a tenant-B freight record referencing tenant-A population; PostgreSQL rejected the insert by composite tenant/population foreign key. Fixture rolled back.

tamper_evident_audit_chain.evidence: Database INSERT triggers append per-tenant SHA-256 audit events under a tenant-scoped advisory lock. recovery_verify_audit_chain recomputes hashes and link continuity. 2026-10-07 synthetic probe returned zero invalid hashes and zero broken links.

api_key_security.evidence: RecoveryOS stores SHA-256 API-key digests only, exposes plaintext once at creation, separates ingest and payment_event scopes, supports owner-only listing without secret material, and supports irreversible revocation.

payment_lifecycle_guards.evidence: Application and PostgreSQL triggers independently enforce owner authorization, exact authorized amount, provider-event amount equality, event chronology, allowed lifecycle transitions, and append-only payment evidence.

immutable_evidence_storage.evidence: Database mutation-blocking triggers reject UPDATE/DELETE for frozen populations, ingress receipts, freight records, incumbent snapshots, findings, review dispositions, payment instructions, payment authorizations, payment events, and audit events.

secrets_management.evidence: Floot project resource inventory shows database and authentication secrets connected as server-side resources (FLOOT_DATABASE_URL and JWT_SECRET); secret values are not returned through project tooling or committed source.

incident_response.evidence: Repository contains fail-closed incident state validation, severity/exposure semantics, notification authorization rules, tabletop materials, and incident documentation. This is not proof of a staffed 24x7 SOC/on-call function.

retention_deletion.evidence: Trust Center and data-lifecycle controls define buyer-specific retention/deletion treatment and prohibit claiming absence as deletion. A universal production retention period is intentionally not asserted.

vulnerability_management.evidence: Repository release gates, deterministic SBOM generation, provenance, attestation payloads, and CI are present. Independent DAST/SAST and external vulnerability-management evidence is not yet attached.

disaster_recovery.evidence: Repository has a semantic backup/restore drill that verifies restored audit/settlement business semantics, but the deployed Floot/Neon customer-data-plane provider backup and restore procedure is not independently evidenced.

parser_sandbox.evidence: The current deployed RecoveryOS customer-data application accepts governed canonical JSON and does not expose a production PDF/archive/document parser runtime. Repository parser/adapters are not treated as a deployed parser sandbox.

mfa.evidence: RecoveryOS password authentication is implemented, but a second-factor control is not currently evidenced. Do not claim MFA.

enterprise_sso.evidence: No SAML/OIDC enterprise SSO control has been evidenced for the production RecoveryOS environment. Do not claim enterprise SSO.

independent_penetration_test.evidence: Internal negative tests exist, but no independent third-party penetration-test report has been performed or attached.

soc2_type2.evidence: No SOC 2 Type II report has been issued for Freight Recovery/RecoveryOS.

iso27001.evidence: No ISO/IEC 27001 certification has been issued for Freight Recovery/RecoveryOS.

provider_encryption_evidence.evidence: The production data plane is Floot-managed PostgreSQL (Neon), but provider-level encryption-at-rest/in-transit evidence has not been independently captured into this repository snapshot. Do not make an encryption claim from assumption.

provider_backup_restore_evidence.evidence: Production-provider backup retention, point-in-time recovery, and tested restore evidence have not been independently captured. The repository semantic drill does not substitute for provider DR evidence.

claim_boundary: This snapshot proves specific application/database controls and synthetic negative tests only.
It is not a SOC 2 report, ISO 27001 certificate, penetration-test report, provider encryption attestation, or provider backup/restore attestation.
Public and buyer-facing claims must keep PENDING_EXTERNAL controls explicitly unproven until independent evidence exists.
RecoveryOS security status can report application control health without promoting external assurance dependencies to passes.
